requiredFiles.description: Landing page del proyecto con HTML semántico

criteria: The page uses semantic HTML5 tags correctly: header, nav, main, section, article, and footer are present and used appropriately (not just divs)
A heading hierarchy is correctly established: there is exactly one h1, with h2 and h3 used for subsections
At least one HTML form is present with proper label elements associated to each input via 'for' and 'id' attributes
All images have descriptive alt attributes (not empty, not 'image')
The page has no CSS styling — this is intentional; the HTML structure should be clean and readable without it
